observations: Three yellow hydraulic pallet jacks standing on a concrete floor.
The jacks have a standard T-shaped handle and a triangular base.
The jacks appear to be in used condition with some visible wear.
The jacks are positioned in a warehouse or storage area with other equipment and a railing visible in the background.
A watermark 'PREYE DOUGLAS77' is visible across the center of the image.

claims.evidence: The physical appearance suggests durability, but 'heavy duty' is a subjective claim about load capacity and material.
The capacity rating is not visible on the jacks in the photo.
The T-shaped handle and the presence of a hydraulic pump on the base are characteristic of manual hydraulic pallet jacks.

claims.claim: Fully working, recently serviced by the dealer, all parts complete. Original from the manufacturer.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The hydraulic pump may be seized or leaking hydraulic fluid.
risks.proof: A video showing the jack being operated to lift and lower.

risks.risk: The hydraulic hoses may be cracked or leaking.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the hydraulic hoses and fittings.

risks.risk: The jacks may have structural damage or rust.
risks.proof: Photos of the underside and the base of the jacks.

proof_requests: Video of the hydraulic pump being operated to demonstrate it is working.
Close-up photo of the hydraulic hoses and fittings.
Photos of the underside and the base of the jacks to check for rust or damage.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
